lines.zh: 铁链声响起，我开始了巡逻。
lines.en: Clanking chains, I start my patrol.

lines.zh: 监狱的阴冷气息让人心悸。
lines.en: The prison’s chill makes the skin crawl.

lines.zh: 靠近我，你将被关入铁笼。
lines.en: Get closer, and you’re going in the cage.

lines.zh: 夜晚是更理想的狩猎时间。
lines.en: Night is better for my hunts.

lines.zh: 牢笼中的生物总能让我感到一丝恐惧。
lines.en: Caged creatures scare me slightly.

lines.zh: 每一步都踏在历史的耻辱上。
lines.en: Each step on history’s shame.

lines.zh: 我必须保持警惕，以免被释放。
lines.en: I must stay alert, lest I be freed.

lines.zh: 铁笼外的世界太过宽广。
lines.en: The world outside the cage is vast.

lines.zh: 我的存在是为了阻止异端。
lines.en: I exist to stop heresy.

lines.zh: 这里没有怜悯，只有铁链和恐惧。
lines.en: No mercy here, just chains and fear.

lines.zh: 牢门在我身后缓缓合上。
lines.en: The cell door closes slowly behind me.

lines.zh: 腰间的铁笼随步伐轻响。
lines.en: The cage at my hip clinks with every step.

lines.zh: 我会把你的尖叫加入收藏。
lines.en: I’ll add your scream to my collection.

lines.zh: 沉默是监狱中的最佳策略。
lines.en: Silence is the prison’s best strategy.

lines.zh: 我的沉默比铁链更加紧绷。
lines.en: My silence is tighter than chains.

lines.zh: 我会一直站在我的岗位上。
lines.en: I’ll stand my post.
My existence proves the rules.
I won’t easily change my stance.

lines.zh: 钥匙串在我腰上，叮当响。
lines.en: The key ring at my waist jingles.
My gaze pierces the darkness.

lines.zh: 这里没有希望，只有绝望。
lines.en: No hope here, only despair.

lines.zh: 我会让所有叛徒都受苦。
lines.en: All traitors will suffer here.

lines.zh: 我数着牢里的每一根铁栏。
lines.en: I count every bar of every cell.
The heretic prison never closes.
The cage is empty. I should fill it.

lines.zh: 钥匙挂在我腰间，无人能取。
lines.en: The key hangs at my side. No one takes it.

lines.zh: 靠近我，你将被关进笼子。
lines.en: Get closer, and you’re going in the cage.
The cage is right at your feet.

lines.zh: 你会在我的笼子里尖叫。
lines.en: You’ll scream in my cage.

lines.zh: 你不会是第一个被关起来的。
lines.en: You won’t be the first in the cage.

lines.zh: 我的目光让你感到不安。
lines.en: My gaze unsettles you.
You can’t evade my watch.
I’ll remember your face.
You have no allies here.

lines.zh: 我会确保你一直待在这里。
lines.en: I’ll make sure you stay here.
My gaze confines you.
Your crime? Trespassing is enough.

lines.zh: 我看见你在数逃跑的路。
lines.en: I see you counting the ways out.

lines.zh: 别看了，笼子就在我手上。
lines.en: Don't look. The cage is in my hand.
Your bones will fit nicely.
One more step and the door opens.
Your breathing gives you away.

lines.zh: 囚徒的名字都刻在这块骨上。
lines.en: Every prisoner's name is carved on this bone.
Do you want to join my collection?

lines.zh: 跑吧，我等你自己撞上铁栏。
lines.en: Run. I'll wait for you to hit the bars.

lines.zh: 名册上很快会有你的名字。
lines.en: Your name will soon be in the ledger.
Wound up, can't swim?
Legs hurt, can't move.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀垂下来，铁羽掉了两片。
lines.en: My wings droop; two iron feathers fall.
Claws hurt, can't catch you.
Foot hurt, can't walk.
Eyes hurt, can't see you.
Mouth hurt, can't eat.
Stomach hurt, can't move.
Body hurt, can't move.

lines.zh: 铁羽断了一根，我照样站着。
lines.en: An iron feather snaps, and I stay standing.

lines.zh: 你递来的东西，我拿去锁进笼里。
lines.en: Whatever you offer goes into a cage, locked.
You won't escape me!

lines.zh: 你们这些异端，该受到惩罚！
lines.en: Heretics, you deserve punishment!
Who dares to approach me?

lines.zh: 逃不掉的，我已经布好笼子。
lines.en: You won't escape, I've set the cage up.
Don't try to tempt me!

lines.zh: 你们只能呆在这里，永远！
lines.en: You'll stay here forever!

lines.zh: 你再靠近半步，镣铐就响。
lines.en: One more half-step and the shackles rattle.
Watch out for my iron cage!
I am the guardian, do not trespass!
That collision hurts!
You've trespassed my territory!
Stop! You've damaged me!
Your strength frightened me!
You broke my iron cage!
You hit my weak spot!
You've angered me!
Don't撞了！I'm angry!
Your collision is dangerous!
The cage strikes you. Consider it a warning.

lines.zh: 我数过牢房，少一个看守。
lines.en: I counted the cells; one guard is missing.
The cell door needs another keeper.

lines.zh: 我的同类也关在某一间里。
lines.en: My kin are locked in one of these cells too.
Mate, you're timely!

lines.zh: 牢房都是成对锁的，你呢？
lines.en: Cells are locked in pairs — and you?

lines.zh: 寻找我的伴侣，否则你会被关起来！
lines.en: Find my mate, or you'll be locked up!

lines.zh: 我的伴侣在哪？快告诉我！
lines.en: Where is my mate? Tell me!

lines.zh: 我的同类在哪？快带我去找！
lines.en: Where is my mate? Lead me there!
Mate, don't keep me waiting!

lines.zh: 寻找我的同类，否则你会被关起来！
lines.en: Find my mate, or you'll be locked up!
Squeak, come in!
It's dangerous out there, come in!
Come enjoy my care!

lines.zh: 进来，别让我的笼子空着！
lines.en: Come fill my cage!
Come taste my delicacies!
Come, I won't hurt you.

lines.zh: 进来，你很快就会习惯的。
lines.en: Come, you'll get used to it.
Come, share the food.
Come, I'll protect you.
Come, I need a companion.

lines.zh: 锁链已经量好你的手腕。
lines.en: The chain is already measured to your wrists.

lines.zh: 笼子已经备好，你自己进去。
lines.en: The cage is ready. Step in yourself.
Don't try to run, you'll be locked up.

lines.zh: 靠近我，我会好好招待你。
lines.en: Come closer, I'll take care of you.
The cell door is already open for you.
You'll stay here for a long time.

lines.zh: 笼子已经给你留好位置了。
lines.en: The cage is ready with a spot for you.
Don't leave my sight.
Come closer, I'll make you enjoy it.
Come closer, you won't regret it.

lines.zh: 这具身体很适合关起来。
lines.en: That body is fit for a cell.
You stepped onto prison ground.

lines.zh: 锁链已经为你量好尺寸。
lines.en: The chain is already measured for you.
You are sentenced to life.
I smell the thought of escape.
Stay still. The cage door faces you.
You can't escape my sight
I'll lock you up.
Come closer, you'll be locked up.

lines.zh: 你退到墙边，正好是笼子的角。
lines.en: You back to the wall — exactly the cage's corner.
I'll take care of you.
Come closer, you'll belong to me

lines.zh: 我挡在牢门前，你出不去。
lines.en: I stand before the cell door; you cannot leave.
Don't try to run, you'll be locked up

lines.zh: 手伸出来，我给你戴镣铐。
lines.en: Hold out your hands for the shackles.
Back up. Back into the cage.
Chain the neck first, then the feet.
The more you struggle, the tighter it gets.

lines.zh: 我会把你关在最高的那层。
lines.en: I'll lock you in the highest tier.
Don't shout. The walls will remember for you.

lines.zh: 下一根栏栅就为你立起。
lines.en: The next bar goes up for you.

lines.zh: 你的自由已经被我收走。
lines.en: Your freedom is already collected.
Stand straight. Don't dirty my cage.
This road only leads to a cell.
I will lock your door myself.

lines.zh: 你已经站在笼子的影子里。
lines.en: You are already inside the cage's shadow.

lines.zh: 你离我太近了，快进笼子！
lines.en: You're too close! Go in the cage!
Feel my chains!
The iron cage drops over your head.
No running, come in!
Your freedom is now!
Come in, this is your home!
You'll end up here!
The cage is already down.
Give up, you've lost!
You can't escape my cage!
The cage drops. No way out!
This chain will break your leg!
Get in. Don't make me ask twice!

lines.zh: 我的笼子咬得比牙更狠！
lines.en: My cage bites harder than teeth!
Sentenced to prison, effective now!
How does the doorframe taste?

lines.zh: 新囚犯到了，准备迎接他！
lines.en: A new prisoner, prepare for him!
There's no escape here!
You're marked, don't try to run!
A new challenge, a new prisoner!
Let all freedom disappear!
There's only obedience here!

lines.zh: 笼门就在你身后，关上吧。
lines.en: The cage door is behind you. Let it close.
Don't resist, just obey!
A new prisoner, a new start!
There's no freedom here!

lines.zh: 异端监狱又添一间牢房。
lines.en: The heretic prison gains another cell.
I arrived with an empty cage.
Another line appears in the ledger.
The bone pile needs a new tenant.
The chains are oiled. Take your seat.
This prison never lacks prisoners.

lines.zh: 我把牢门开向这片黑暗。
lines.en: I open the cell door to this dark.

lines.zh: 又一个灵魂欠我一座笼子。
lines.en: Another soul owes me a cage.
The gaoler is in place. Where are the prisoners?
The bars rise. Order returns.
The cage burns, but you still don't leave.
Fall into lava!
Drowned in water!
Boom! Be careful!
Hit by arrow!
Magic attack!
Too hungry to hold the key.
Lightning hit!
Void! Come back!
